info.name: WAB Admin API
info.description: Generated by `npm run docs`. Do not edit by hand.

item.name: Auth
Step 1: password

request.description: A correct password emails a one-time code to the admin; it does not open a session. Wrong passwords count toward the lockout (429 while locked). Asking again inside `resendAfterSeconds` does not send another code.

item.name: Step 2: emailed code

request.description: The right code opens the session (once). Errors: `OTP_INVALID`, `OTP_EXPIRED` (401), 429 while locked. A wrong code counts toward the same lockout as a wrong password.

item.name: Rotate the refresh token

request.description: Keeps an active session alive. A session idle for longer than `admin.sessionIdleSec` has an expired refresh token (401); reusing an old token ends the session.

item.name: Log out

request.description: Revokes the refresh token. Always succeeds for a well-formed token.

item.name: Change the password

request.description: A wrong current password counts toward the sign-in lockout and answers 403 `CURRENT_PASSWORD_INVALID` (not 401, so the panel keeps the session); 429 while locked. The new password is at least 12 characters and differs from the current one (422 `VALIDATION_ERROR`). Every session of the admin ends: sign in again.

item.name: Step 1 of an email change: code to the new address

request.description: Needs the current password (same lockout rules, 403 `CURRENT_PASSWORD_INVALID`). The new address must be free (409 `EMAIL_ALREADY_USED`). A code is emailed to the NEW address; nothing changes until step 2.

item.name: Step 2 of an email change: confirm the code

request.description: The right code (once, 5 minutes) changes the sign-in email and ends every session. Errors: 422 `OTP_INVALID` / `OTP_EXPIRED`; a wrong code counts toward the lockout (429 while locked); 409 `EMAIL_ALREADY_USED` if the address was taken meanwhile.
